ideas.title: Uncovering the Extent of Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of the child care fraud scandal in Minnesota, including the number of individuals and organizations involved, and the total amount of funds lost.
questions: How widespread is the child care fraud scandal in Minnesota?
What is the total amount of funds lost?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale scandal, and could lead to further investigations and prosecutions. By following the money, we can identify the key players and uncover the full extent of the fraud.
